free_tier.stated: 1 TB of data in OneLake, free for 60 days.

egress.terms: Not separately metered during trial; capacity is F4 or F64 SKU consumption.

tooling: Genuinely excellent interface: OneLake speaks the ADLS Gen2 DFS API and the Blob API - https://onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/<workspace>/<item>.<type>/<path>, plus an ABFS driver URI. Any Azure Storage SDK or rclone 'azureblob' remote can talk to it. 1 TB beats most free tiers on volume.
chaining: Trials are per-user/per-tenant, so theoretically N accounts x 1 TB x 60 days - but the trial expires and the data does not survive usefully.
limits_note: 60 days only. On expiry, non-Power BI items become inactive and 'All content remains stored in OneLake for 7 days' before being inaccessible. Then needs a paid F or P capacity.

identity_cost.detail: inferred from the category 'iaas'; the source record states no identity cost, so this is a class assumption, not evidence

reliability_note: Hard 60-day expiry with a 7-day grace window - this is a trial, not storage. Fine for a one-off bulk ingest/egress burst, useless for a 20 TB archive.

evidence.proved: 'free access for 60 days'; 'Store up to 1 TB of data in OneLake'; 'All content remains stored in OneLake for 7 days'

'OneLake provides open access to all of your Fabric items through existing Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) and Blob APIs'; 'https://onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/<workspace>/<item>.<itemtype>/<path>/<fileName>'
